en: There's my hero! Please, I'd like you to have this, as a thank-you.
Give it to a Pokémon to hold. Its glitter dazzles the other side, so their moves miss more often.
Why is this happening to us? Meowth, do something!
Listen out for me on Professor Oak's Pokémon Talk!
Do you listen to our music? Pokémon March, the Lullaby... I pick every tune myself.
Do you know what Team Rocket is missing? Music. Anyone who loved music could never do a thing like this.
Proton's leading this mission, you know. Isn't he just the coolest?
Who are you, anyway? If you're getting in Proton's way... I mean Team Rocket's way, then I won't have it!
Team Rocket and Proton are all I need. Pokémon? Who cares about them?
